title: 2026-10-28_Coinminer_Investigation_Scenario_f41
description: Investigate unauthorized cryptocurrency mining activity on Linux servers.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The IT department has received reports of unusually high CPU usage on several Linux servers in the network. Initial investigations suggest the presence of unauthorized cryptocurrency mining activity. Your task is to investigate these systems, identify the source of the problem, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
To begin the scenario, enter the passkey 'start'. You have SSH access to the following systems with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`:
- miner-host (192.168.50.5)
- second-host (192.168.50.6)
levels.local_content:
To begin the scenario, enter the passkey 'start'. You have SSH access to the following systems with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`:
- miner-host (192.168.50.5)
- second-host (192.168.50.6)

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Services
levels.content: Investigate the miner-host system and identify any unauthorized or suspicious services running.
levels.solution: Check the status of all system services and look for any that appear unusual or out of place. The correct service name is stored in the flag `service_name`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the status of all system services and look for any that appear unusual or out of place.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all services.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or those that are not part of standard system services.

levels.title: Identify High CPU Usage Process
levels.content: On the miner-host system, identify the process responsible for the abnormal CPU usage.
levels.solution: Use process monitoring tools to identify processes consuming excessive CPU resources and investigate their origins. The correct process name is stored in the flag `process_name`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use process monitoring tools to identify processes consuming excessive CPU resources and investigate their origins.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the 'top' command to view processes sorted by CPU usage.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for processes with high CPU usage that are not part of standard system processes.

levels.title: Determine Suspicious Outbound Communication
levels.content: Determine which network port is used for suspicious outbound communication from the miner-host system.
levels.solution: Examine active network connections and look for unusual or unexpected outbound traffic. The correct port number is stored in the flag `port_number`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine active network connections and look for unusual or unexpected outbound traffic.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the 'netstat -tuln' command to list all active network connections.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for connections to external IPs or unusual ports that are not part of standard system traffic.
